study.question: Does the native click-orthogonal auxiliary context component require its original sign to benefit click prediction when the click-parallel component is absent, and does parallel-component presence change that sign effect?
study.hypothesis: The native O component carries a direction-specific contribution: +O should outperform -O even after removing P. The latest O-only click AUC 0.6682887435699238 nearly matches C=0.6682972490126902 and exceeds blocked=0.6678548720585206, whereas P alone=0.6678178597099826. These single-seed outcomes do not establish that O sign rather than its nonzero magnitude matters. Previous reflection C-2O scored 0.6677662770959951 with P retained. A 2x2 O-sign by native-P-presence study closes that missing interaction contrast without changing the forward model or private supervision.

study.proposed_difference: Relax only the O-orientation guard while keeping P sign aligned. predictions: Primary predeclared contrast: D_absent=AUC(orthogonal_native_replay)-AUC(orthogonal_reversed)>0. The +O arm should replay g3-r0047-orthogonal_native before scientific interpretation.
D_present=AUC(centered_native_replay)-AUC(orthogonal_reflected_bridge)>0, consistent with g3-r0045 reflection evidence. Report I=D_present-D_absent without assuming zero interaction.
Native +O and C replays should reproduce their original fixed-seed endpoints. +O versus C ordering is descriptive; the prior 0.0000085054 difference is not evidence of equivalence or superiority.

At a common fixed state, prediction values, losses, private gradients, state updates and click cotangent match; +/-O norms match, C and C-2O norms match, and occupied-row auxiliary sums remain approximately zero in FP64.

Parameter counts remain 32192421 total, 31793216 embedding and 399205 dense as inherited receipts. Inference follows unchanged code; measured throughput/latency may fluctuate and are not promised equal.
falsifiers: No reproducible +O advantage over -O falsifies the proposed signed-O utility in the absent-P stratum; an apparent tie does not prove equivalence.
A sign effect only when P is present falsifies a P-independent interpretation and calls for interaction-specific explanation.
If +O no longer improves on a matched blocked control under authorized repetitions, the earlier O utility claim remains unsupported beyond its original seed.

Forward/private-gradient mismatch, nonfinite reduction, changed empty-history transfer, failed native replay or source/recipe mismatch invalidates the claimed controlled contrast rather than refuting the scientific mechanism.
Results do not establish production validity under delayed feedback, parameter-space orthogonality, a new optimizer objective, or superiority over the incumbent joint model.
alternative_explanations: Orthogonality and equal norms concern occupied example/context cotangents before repeated-ID scatter; shared feature IDs, sparse Adagrad and dense AdamW can change parameter-space geometry and step sizes.
Each arm recomputes its own C, K, P and O at its evolving model state. Matched norms apply at fixed state, not across independently trained trajectories.
Single frozen seed; deterministic implementation replays are not independent replications. Many earlier validation-adaptive decisions make this an exploratory mechanistic follow-up.

Sign reversal is an explicit first-order surrogate VJP, not the derivative of the identity forward and not an ordinary scalar-objective optimizer. A generic sign-sensitive optimization effect remains possible.

Auxiliary label semantics are 24h same-user/category/brand matches, not advertisement-specific conversion attribution; offline action visibility can change the meaning and transferability of auxiliary supervision.
Earlier collected float32 and float64 outcomes differed substantially; algebraic equivalence alone does not control cancellation, graph accumulation or optimization trajectories.

O direction can act through feature frequency, repeated identifiers or normalization-sensitive optimization rather than uniquely useful auxiliary semantic information. Sign reversal narrows an unsigned-norm explanation but does not isolate semantics.

validation_plan.phase: Proposal and static validation only. The coding environment has no torch. The host owns execution; the following are requested prerequisites, not completed tests or a claim that an unregistered diagnostic interface exists.
before_training: Host verify source/config hashes, protocol identity and inherited input readiness. At identical initialized parameters/buffers and RNG, compare train/eval outputs and state updates of all four arms with parent; compare parameter names, shapes and initialization exactly. Preserve historical fields/actions, task masks, missing inputs and empty-history masking.

Host direct first-order collector checks under actual bf16 autocast: arbitrary distinct click/auxiliary cotangents; all occupied, mixed occupied, all empty, one occupied, K=0, C=0, C parallel to K, C orthogonal to K, tiny finite magnitudes and cancellation-heavy task sums. Enforce zero auxiliary transfer on unoccupied rows; preserve the entire click cotangent there and elsewhere.

In FP64 check C=P+O and <P,O>=0 within scale-aware tolerance, zero occupied-row means, equal norms for +/-O and C/C-2O, reflection twice recovers C, and finite returned gradients. Use relative tolerance 1e-10 with absolute bound 1e-12 times a scale of max input norm and float64 tiny. Treat failures at degenerate/underflow values separately instead of hiding with a large fixed epsilon.

Host compare actual custom backward against an independently written reference using the same cast boundary and original click cotangent. For aligned O/C demand exact outputs of the parent collector on the same tensors; verify all private task derivatives and unaffected item/action/scorer paths agree at fixed state. Do not use ordinary finite-difference gradcheck to assert identity-forward derivative correctness; this is a prescribed surrogate VJP.
If these host checks cannot be run by the authorized interface, record them as unverified and do not elevate validation AUC differences into controlled mechanism support.
replay_gates: At the frozen seed, compare +O replay to g3-r0047-orthogonal_native (AUC 0.6682887435699238) and C replay to g3-r0047-centered_native_bridge (0.6682972490126902). Same graph/direct endpoint selection should reproduce trajectories. Any unexplained mismatch blocks mechanism attribution; do not choose an after-the-fact loose AUC tolerance.

Compare C-2O with historical g3-r0045-orthogonal_reflected64 (0.6677662770959951) as a cross-implementation bridge. There is no available ancestor source for that earlier trial; receipt/config provenance is verified, so bitwise equivalence is not asserted. If it differs, keep the within-suite contrast exploratory and inspect arithmetic before citing historical confirmation.

Historical blocked=0.6678548720585206 and P-only=0.6678178597099826 are same-seed anchors from the prior deletion suite, not newly executed controls or independent support. Any nonnative/failed replay requires a new matched zero-transfer control before claiming benefit over blocked.
reporting: Use full-population validation click AUC as primary; report four task AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean separately, plus D_absent, D_present and I. Keep all cells, including negative results.
Report actual train/total/allocated GPU time, examples, peak memory, parameters, inference throughput and p50/p95 batch latency; distinguish matched recipe from an unmeasured equal-compute claim.

Use existing predeclared history bins with sample/positive/negative counts; mark unavailable hour/frequency/composition/missing-field diagnostics as unavailable rather than inventing them. Treat new slice findings as exploratory.

Request paired user-cluster intervals only if the host can provide them through the authorized validation interface; repeated exposures are not independent. No invented intervals or significance from one seed. Replays do not count as independent seeds.

observations.observation: Trajectory index: joint click AUC 0.668457307890924, click-only 0.6678548720585206, batch-rolled auxiliary labels 0.6674639465810746. These motivate informative auxiliary-supervision controls; they do not by themselves establish a mechanism or seed robustness.

Execution succeeded but intended equivalent/collected trajectories differed: r0039 centered replay 0.6676314512972833, r0041 aggregate32 0.6674397049498135 versus aggregate64 0.6682972490126902. Preserve these scientifically unsuccessful numerical branches; retain joint FP64 collector and direct native endpoints rather than asserting algebraic equivalence ensures experimental equivalence.

Full-norm O/P scored 0.6681098136884872/0.6678762177357972; native O/P scored 0.6682887435699238/0.6678178597099826. Norm-rescaled components did not improve on native C=0.6682972490126902. Native deletion, rather than additional norm amplification, motivates the present sign contrast.

Native O retained most observed C benefit; P alone did not. Earlier O reflection retained P, leaving the sign effect without P unresolved. Proposed direction-specific O utility remains provisional, and no lower AUC versus joint incumbent is hidden.
